No LegendAgent reference - maybe user context incorrect.

Let me check the swarm module to find how to enable DeveloperAgent:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check swarm directory
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/swarm/")
print("Swarm:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check if developer agent is being used
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'DeveloperAgent' /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/swarm/services/DeveloperAgent.ts | head -5")
print("Dev:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
